title: UX Form Flow Compiler
description: Validates form flow specs: required field validation rules, server error mapping, multi-step progress indicators, draft behavior, success targets, and abandonment handling. Produces form-flow-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract form-flow-spec.json from feature brief and field definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and required field validation rules

pipeline.title: Behavior
pipeline.description: Validate server error mapping, multi-step progress, and draft behavior

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate success target and abandonment handling

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: form-flow-spec.json exists with form_id, fields array, and submission object

gates.title: Required Fields Valid
gates.description: Every field with required:true has at least one validation rule

gates.title: Server Error Mapping
gates.description: If serverErrors array exists, every entry has code and userMessage

gates.title: Multi-Step Progress
gates.description: Multi-step forms declare progressIndicator per step or globalProgressIndicator

gates.title: Draft Behavior
gates.description: When draftEnabled:true, draftSaveTrigger and draftStorageKey must be declared

gates.title: Success Target
gates.description: submission must declare redirectTo or onSuccess — no form without a success outcome

gates.title: Abandoned Handling
gates.description: Multi-step forms must declare abandonedBehavior: save-draft|discard|warn-then-discard

gates.title: Form Flow Contract
gates.description: Version, unique field ids, id+type on each field, submission.method declared

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled form flow specs

error_codes.UFF001: form-flow-spec.json missing or invalid — form_id, fields, submission required
error_codes.UFF002: Required field missing validation rules — required:true fields need validations array
error_codes.UFF003: serverErrors entry missing code or userMessage
error_codes.UFF005: draftEnabled:true but draftSaveTrigger or draftStorageKey missing
error_codes.UFF006: submission missing success target — declare redirectTo or onSuccess
error_codes.UFF008: Form flow contract violation — version, unique ids, field types, or submission method missing
